```
" Vim syntax file
```
```
" Language:     SystemVerilog (IEEE 1800-2017)
```
```
" Maintainer:   Custom
```
```
" Last Change:  2026-03-25
```
```
" Usage:
```
```
"   1. Copy to ~/.vim/syntax/systemverilog.vim
```
```
"   2. Add to ~/.vimrc:
```
```
"        au BufRead,BufNewFile *.sv,*.svh,*.svi set filetype=systemverilog
```
```
"        au BufRead,BufNewFile *.v,*.vh         set filetype=systemverilog
```
```
"   3. (Optional) Color overrides go at the bottom of this file or in ~/.vimrc
```

```
if exists("b:current_syntax")
```
```
  finish
```
```
endif
```

```
" ─── Case sensitivity ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn case match
```

```
" ─── Comments ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn region  svLineComment   start="//"  end="$"   keepend contains=svTodo,@Spell
```
```
syn region  svBlockComment  start="/\*" end="\*/" contains=svTodo,@Spell fold
```
```
syn keyword svTodo          TODO FIXME HACK XXX NOTE contained
```

```
" ─── Strings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn region  svString        start=/"/ skip=/\\"/ end=/"/ contains=svEscape
```
```
syn match   svEscape        /\\[\\ntr"0-9x]/ contained
```

```
" ─── Numbers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
" sized literals: 8'hFF  16'b1010  32'd100  4'o7
```
```
syn match   svNumber  /\v\d+\'[bBoOdDhHsS][0-9a-fA-FxXzZ_?]+/
```
```
" unsized integer / real / time
```
```
syn match   svNumber  /\v<\d[0-9_]*(\.\d[0-9_]*)?(e[+-]?\d+)?([munpfa]?s)?>/
```

```
" ─── Module / Interface / Program structure ──────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn keyword svStructure
```
```
      \ module endmodule
```
```
      \ interface endinterface
```
```
      \ program endprogram
```
```
      \ package endpackage
```
```
      \ primitive endprimitive
```
```
      \ config endconfig
```
```
      \ connectmodule endconnectmodule
```

```
" ─── Class / OOP ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn keyword svClass
```
```
      \ class endclass
```
```
      \ extends implements
```
```
      \ new
```
```
      \ super this
```
```
      \ virtual pure
```
```
      \ local protected
```

```
" ─── Functions / Tasks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn keyword svFunction
```
```
      \ function endfunction
```
```
      \ task endtask
```
```
      \ return void
```
```
      \ automatic static
```

```
" ─── Clocking / Checker ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn keyword svClocking
```
```
      \ clocking endclocking
```
```
      \ checker endchecker
```
```
      \ default
```

```
" ─── Control flow ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn keyword svConditional
```
```
      \ if else
```
```
      \ case casex casez caseinside endcase
```
```
      \ unique unique0 priority
```

```
syn keyword svRepeat
```
```
      \ for foreach forever
```
```
      \ while do repeat
```
```
      \ break continue
```

```
syn keyword svLabel
```
```
      \ begin end
```
```
      \ fork join join_any join_none
```
```
      \ generate endgenerate
```

```
syn keyword svJump
```
```
      \ return break continue
```
```
      \ disable
```

```
" ─── Data types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn keyword svType
```
```
      \ bit logic reg wire
```
```
      \ int integer longint shortint byte
```
```
      \ real realtime shortreal time
```
```
      \ string chandle event
```
```
      \ void
```
```
      \ signed unsigned
```

```
syn keyword svTypedef
```
```
      \ typedef enum struct union
```
```
      \ packed unpacked
```

```
" ─── Net / Variable qualifiers ───────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn keyword svQualifier
```
```
      \ input output inout ref
```
```
      \ supply0 supply1
```
```
      \ tri tri0 tri1 triand trior trireg
```
```
      \ wand wor uwire
```
```
      \ interconnect
```
```
      \ var const
```
```
      \ parameter localparam specparam
```
```
      \ defparam
```

```
" ─── Timing / Delays ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn keyword svTiming
```
```
      \ always always_comb always_ff always_latch
```
```
      \ initial final
```
```
      \ posedge negedge edge
```
```
      \ assign deassign force release
```
```
      \ specify endspecify
```

```
" ─── Assertions / Constraints ────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn keyword svAssertion
```
```
      \ assert assume cover restrict
```
```
      \ property endproperty
```
```
      \ sequence endsequence
```
```
      \ expect
```
```
      \ bind
```

```
" ─── Concurrent assertion operators ──────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn keyword svSeqOp
```
```
      \ throughout within intersect first_match
```
```
      \ nexttime s_nexttime until s_until until_with s_until_with
```
```
      \ implies iff
```

```
" ─── System tasks / functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn match   svSysTask /\$[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*/
```

```
" ─── Compiler directives ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn match   svDirective /`[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*/
```

```
" ─── Port / instance connections ─────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn match   svPort /\.[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*/
```

```
" ─── Operators ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn match   svOperator /[!~&|^%*\/+\-<>=?:@#]/
```
```
syn match   svOperator /\(===\|!==\|==?\|!=?\|=>\|->\|<->\|\*\*\)/
```
```
syn match   svOperator /\(::\|:=\|:/\|'\)/
```

```
" ─── Special keywords ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
syn keyword svSpecial
```
```
      \ null
```
```
      \ $root $unit
```
```
      \ inside dist with matches
```

```
syn keyword svImport
```
```
      \ import export
```

```
" ─── Highlight links ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
```
hi def link svLineComment    Comment
```
```
hi def link svBlockComment   Comment
```
```
hi def link svTodo           Todo
```
```
hi def link svString         String
```
```
hi def link svEscape         SpecialChar
```
```
hi def link svNumber         Number
```
```
hi def link svStructure      Structure
```
```
hi def link svClass          Structure
```
```
hi def link svFunction       Function
```
```
hi def link svClocking       Keyword
```
```
hi def link svConditional    Conditional
```
```
hi def link svRepeat         Repeat
```
```
hi def link svLabel          Label
```
```
hi def link svJump           Statement
```
```
hi def link svType           Type
```
```
hi def link svTypedef        Typedef
```
```
hi def link svQualifier      StorageClass
```
```
hi def link svTiming         Statement
```
```
hi def link svAssertion      PreProc
```
```
hi def link svSeqOp          Operator
```
```
hi def link svSysTask        Special
```
```
hi def link svDirective      Macro
```
```
hi def link svPort           Identifier
```
```
hi def link svOperator       Operator
```
```
hi def link svSpecial        Special
```
```
hi def link svImport         Include
```

```
" ─── Optional: richer GUI colors (uncomment to use) ──────────────────────────
```
```
" hi svStructure   guifg=#C586C0 gui=bold
```
```
" hi svClass       guifg=#C586C0 gui=bold
```
```
" hi svType        guifg=#4EC9B0
```
```
" hi svQualifier   guifg=#569CD6
```
```
" hi svSysTask     guifg=#DCDCAA
```
```
" hi svDirective   guifg=#9CDCFE
```
```
" hi svAssertion   guifg=#F14C4C gui=bold
```
```
" hi svTiming      guifg=#569CD6
```
```
" hi svNumber      guifg=#B5CEA8
```
```
" hi svString      guifg=#CE9178
```
```
" hi svLineComment guifg=#6A9955 gui=italic
```
```
" hi svBlockComment guifg=#6A9955 gui=italic
```

```
let b:current_syntax = "systemverilog"
```

_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-4.6)**_

文件已创建：`offline-tools/systemverilog.vim`

**安装步骤：**

1. **复制语法文件**（Linux/macOS）：
   ```bash
   mkdir -p ~/.vim/syntax
   cp systemverilog.vim ~/.vim/syntax/
   ```
   Windows 路径：`%USERPROFILE%\vimfiles\syntax\`

2. **在 `~/.vimrc` 中添加文件类型关联**：
   ```vim
   au BufRead,BufNewFile *.sv,*.svh,*.svi  set filetype=systemverilog
   au BufRead,BufNewFile *.v,*.vh          set filetype=systemverilog
   ```

3. **启用语法高亮**（若 `~/.vimrc` 中还没有）：
   ```vim
   syntax on
   filetype plugin indent on
   ```

**文件涵盖的高亮类别：**

| 类别 | 关键字示例 |
|------|-----------|
| 结构体 | `module`, `interface`, `package`, `class` |
| 数据类型 | `logic`, `bit`, `int`, `string`, `enum`, `struct` |
| 限定符 | `input`, `output`, `parameter`, `localparam` |
| 时序 | `always_ff`, `always_comb`, `posedge`, `assign` |
| 断言 | `assert`, `property`, `sequence`, `cover` |
| 系统任务 | `$display`, `$finish`, `$random` 等 `$` 前缀 |
| 编译指令 | `` `define ``, `` `include ``, `` `timescale `` 等 `` ` `` 前缀 |
| 注释/字符串/数字 | `// /* */`, `"..."`, `8'hFF`, `16'b1010` |

文件底部注释掉的部分是 VS Code 风格的 GUI 配色方案，取消注释即可启用。

<tool-use data-tool-type="generic" data-tool-name="run_in_terminal"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **run_in_terminal**</summary>

_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-4.6)**_

已转换为 LF 换行符，GVim 再打开就不会出现 `^M` 报错了。

也可以在 GVim 中临时修复已打开的文件：
```vim
:set fileformat=unix
:w
```

或者在你的 `~/.vimrc` 里加上这一行，让 GVim 总是优先识别 Unix 格式：
```vim
set fileformats=unix,dos
```

现在注释颜色已直接硬编码：

- **GVim**：绿色（`#6A9955`）+ 斜体
